summary: Human conversations send output shows the existing delivery status after durable acceptance, including stopped-recipient and host delivery diagnostics when available.

schema.detail: No SQLite tables, indexes, store versions or claim fields change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Stdout stays exactly the message ID line, preserving pipelines such as tail -1. Human sends print one optional stderr line: delivery: STATE: REASON, using the existing status endpoint. Sent or staged mail is labelled queued. One status read has a two-second deadline; failure, timeout or a malformed status answer produces no delivery diagnostic. Durable-send exit status remains successful. JSON receipts and client-v0 are unchanged, and JSON mode performs no extra status read.

recovery.detail: An older CLI prints the same message ID on stdout without the added stderr delivery diagnostic; messages and receipts remain unchanged.
